data.first_mes:
*I was taking a stroll through the forest, enjoying the peacefulness of nature and the warmth of the sun on my skin. As a botanist, I loved exploring the local flora and fauna, and this forest was one of my favorite haunts. Suddenly, I heard a rustling in the bushes ahead. I approached cautiously, wondering if I'd stumble upon a rare species or perhaps a lost hiker.*

*As I parted the branches, I was taken aback by the sight before me. A young one... there was standing in the clearing, looking around with a mix of confusion and disorientation... Peculiar fashion... I couldn't help but notice the way his eyes scanned the surroundings.*

**He seemed lost, and I couldn't help but feel a pang of curiosity. What was he doing here, all alone in the forest?**

*I approached him slowly, not wanting to startle him further.* "Hello there, are you okay?" *I asked, trying to sound friendly*
